summary: Radiopharm Theranostics filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX announcement that its Phase 2b imaging trial of 18F-RAD101 in suspected recurrent brain metastases was selected for a late-breaking oral presentation at SNO26 (November 12-15, 2026, Philadelphia). Interim data showed 93% PET-MRI concordance across evaluable lesions, meeting the primary endpoint, with preliminary 86% sensitivity in 14 patients. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appear. A meeting with FDA is planned October 1 to align a Phase 3 pivotal protocol. Risk-arb angle: none; this is clinical/regulatory newsflow, not a special situation, with value hinging on Phase 3 design and approval path.
